description: This file implements system notification handling for an Android app, including permission checks, notification channel management, and posting notifications.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods for posting notifications and checking authorization.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for Android, managing notification channels and permissions.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Handles system notifications, including permission checks, request parsing, and posting notifications.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a notification based on the provided request.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures a notification channel exists for the given priority.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts priority string to NotificationCompat priority constant.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the sound setting indicates silent mode.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Main method to handle notification requests, including validation and posting.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a JsonObject.
